findings.highlight: "What? That can't be true! Did you forget the part where you Projected Saber's sword!? That would have cost a normal person their arm!"
findings.evidenceJa: 「はあ？　そんな訳ないでしょ、セイバーの剣を投影したのよ？　あんなの、腕一本壊死してもおかしくない芸当じゃない！」
findings.governingReading: 腕一本壊死してもおかしくない says an arm becoming necrotic would not be surprising after that feat.
findings.explanation: Possible arm necrosis becomes a definite normal-person cost.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka mutters quietly to herself as she inspects my arm.
findings.evidenceJa: ぶつぶつと呟く遠坂の吐息が腕にかかる。
findings.governingReading: Her muttering breath touches his arm, heightening his reaction to bodily proximity.
findings.explanation: Rin's breath falling on his arm disappears.

findings.highlight: "Your body really is unbelievable. This isn't how normal healing works. Your natural healing is obviously being bolstered by something external, but this...you healed this yourself."
findings.evidenceJa: 「ふざけた体ね。これ、例の自然治癒による回復じゃないわよ。士郎の自然治癒は明らかに外部からの働きかけだけど、こっちは貴方自身の治癒能力だと思う」
findings.governingReading: 例の自然治癒 points to the previously observed external recovery mechanism, contrasted with what she thinks is his own ability.
findings.explanation: This is not his familiar natural-healing recovery becomes this is not normal healing.

findings.highlight: "Your body really is unbelievable. This isn't how normal healing works. Your natural healing is obviously being bolstered by something external, but this...you healed this yourself."
findings.evidenceJa: 「ふざけた体ね。これ、例の自然治癒による回復じゃないわよ。士郎の自然治癒は明らかに外部からの働きかけだけど、こっちは貴方自身の治癒能力だと思う」
findings.governingReading: 貴方自身の治癒能力だと思う explicitly marks her view as a hypothesis.
findings.explanation: Rin's hypothesis of his own healing becomes a fact.

findings.highlight: I feel like Tohsaka's only teasing me harder now.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂のヤツ、日増しに俺をからかう率が高くなってないか？
findings.governingReading: 日増しに...率が高く names how often she teases him increasing day by day.
findings.explanation: Increasing teasing frequency becomes harder teasing.

findings.highlight: "Tohsaka? Um...this is supposed to be lecture, right? I get nervous when you go all quiet like that."
findings.evidenceJa: 「遠坂？　その、レクチャーだよな、これって。黙っていられると俺も困るんだが」
findings.governingReading: They are in the particular tutor lesson he came for.
findings.explanation: The count noun lecture lacks an article.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka is actually angry.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂は確かに、俺に対して敵意を持っている—
findings.governingReading: 俺に対して敵意 specifies antagonism toward the narrator.
findings.explanation: Hostility directed at Shirou becomes generic anger.

findings.highlight: I had a feeling this was the case when I saw all the junk in your shed. There's no point in being mad about you at this stage."
findings.evidenceJa: そんな事、アンタの蔵を見た時から薄々感づいてたんだから。今更、衛宮士郎に殺意を抱いても仕方ない」
findings.governingReading: 衛宮士郎に殺意を抱く specifies murderous intent/feeling as something pointless to entertain now.
findings.explanation: Explicit murderous feeling becomes merely being mad about Shirou.

findings.highlight: That's why you pass magical energy through yourself! You need it to interact with nature!"
findings.evidenceJa: だから物に魔力を通したり、魔力をスターターにして自然干渉を行うんじゃない！」
findings.governingReading: Rin explains using energy through objects or using it as a starter for interference with nature, in contrast with treating free-standing energy as durable material.
findings.explanation: Rin's explanation of passing energy into objects becomes passing it through oneself. The English also drops her distinction between energy used as material and energy used to initiate an effect on nature.

findings.highlight: "Listen, things made purely from magical energy do not last long. They only briefly take shape.
findings.evidenceJa: 「いい？　魔力だけで作り上げた物は長続きしないものだし、あくまでカタチだけのものよ。
findings.governingReading: 長続きしない states short duration separately; あくまでカタチだけのもの limits what has been reproduced to form alone.
findings.explanation: Only the form of an object becomes form lasting only briefly.

findings.highlight: ...when Kiritsugu was teaching me magecraft, I showed him my half-assed attempt at Projection, but he told me to stick to Strengthening because what I was doing instead was inefficient.
findings.evidenceJa: 切嗣に魔術を教わる時、まず投影じみた事をやったら、それは効率が悪いから強化にしなさい、と言われたっけ。
findings.governingReading: 投影じみた names what the exercise resembled, before Kiritsugu recommends efficiency through Strengthening.
findings.explanation: A Projection-like childhood attempt becomes a half-assed attempt.

findings.highlight: Now let's say you use the same magical energy to Strengthen a sword. That same amount of magical energy can make the sword twenty to thirty times stronger, which means it would last a few hundred times longer than anything you create with Projection."
findings.evidenceJa: 対して、十の魔力を使って剣を“強化”した場合、その剣の力は二十にも三十にも跳ね上がる。加えてその持続時間は“投影”の何百倍よ」
findings.governingReading: With ten input, Projection gives power three or four; with the same ten, Strengthening gives power twenty or thirty.
findings.explanation: The equal-input power illustration becomes an unsupported multiplication factor.

findings.highlight: Now let's say you use the same magical energy to Strengthen a sword. That same amount of magical energy can make the sword twenty to thirty times stronger, which means it would last a few hundred times longer than anything you create with Projection."
findings.evidenceJa: 対して、十の魔力を使って剣を“強化”した場合、その剣の力は二十にも三十にも跳ね上がる。加えてその持続時間は“投影”の何百倍よ」
findings.governingReading: 加えて adds persistence hundreds of times that of Projection as another advantage.
findings.explanation: A further duration advantage becomes a consequence of the strength multiplier.

findings.highlight: Its sole use is creating replicas which disappear the moment they're used, and then only as a substitute for tools you can't normally create or get hold of.
findings.evidenceJa: 道具が揃えられなかった時の代用品として、すぐに消える複製品を用意する為の魔術にすぎない。
findings.governingReading: すぐに消える describes short-lived replicas made when ritual tools cannot be assembled.
findings.explanation: Quickly vanishing copies become copies consumed the moment they are used.

findings.highlight: You have only so many Magic Circuits to begin with, so if he taught you something as wasteful as Projection, he'd be no better than an amateur himself."
findings.evidenceJa: ただでさえ魔術回路が少ないんだから、“投影”なんて無駄な魔術を教えたら一般人と変わらないもの」
findings.governingReading: Shirou's few circuits would make a wasteful-only magical practice leave him no better than an ordinary nonmage.
findings.explanation: Shirou being little different from an ordinary person becomes Kiritsugu being an amateur.

findings.highlight: The golden sword I imagined was real for a moment, and it even had the real sword's power...
findings.evidenceJa: 頭の中でイメージし、現実に複製した黄金の剣は、確かに本来の力を持っていたようだが……。
findings.governingReading: 持っていたようだが is his observed impression and unresolved objection to the rule.
findings.explanation: The sword seeming to possess its original power becomes definitely possessing it.

findings.highlight: For you, it's clearly swords."
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方はそれが“剣”なんだと思う」
findings.governingReading: なんだと思う and preceding きっと are Rin's explanatory hypothesis.
findings.explanation: An inferred sword attribute becomes clearly established.

findings.highlight: ...Most of these mages don't see any time in the spotlight. They're considered unusual."
findings.evidenceJa: ……大抵そういう魔術師は中央には入れず、突出した専門家として名を馳せるらしいけど」
findings.governingReading: 中央に入れず distinguishes exclusion from the center; 専門家として名を馳せる nevertheless grants renown as a specialist.
findings.explanation: Fame as an exceptional specialist becomes no time in the spotlight.

findings.highlight: "Besides, trying to replicate Saber's sword was suicidal. You made it work this time, but I wouldn't have been surprised if you'd just...exploded.
findings.evidenceJa: 「それにね、セイバーの剣を模造するなんて、そんなのは自殺行為よ。あの時は上手くいったからいいものの、本来なら自滅していてもおかしくなかった。
findings.governingReading: 自滅 is the ruinous possible cost of exceeding his circuits; later speech specifies burned circuits, nerves and disability.
findings.explanation: Self-destruction is specified as exploding.

findings.highlight: Even if they're not ever actually able to pull off that miracle, they'll still take a shot.
findings.evidenceJa: たとえ自分では再現不可能の奇蹟だって判っていても、それにチャレンジする事は誰にでも出来る。
findings.governingReading: チャレンジする事は誰にでも出来る concerns access to the attempt, not the decision to attempt.
findings.explanation: Anyone being able to attempt the impossible becomes mages actually taking a shot.

findings.highlight: Even a small engine can reach a high speed if you push the gas hard enough. But it tends to be self-destructive."
findings.evidenceJa: 小さなエンジンでも、アクセルを踏み続けていれば規定以上のスピードは出る。けど、その先にあるのは自滅しかない」
findings.governingReading: 規定以上 is above the specified limit; その先には自滅しかない supplies the destructive destination.
findings.explanation: Exceeding an engine's rated speed with only destruction ahead becomes reaching high speed that tends to be destructive.

findings.highlight: "That's why you should always keep in mind:
findings.evidenceJa: 「……だから、覚えておきなさい衛宮くん。
findings.governingReading: 衛宮くん marks a newly deliberate surname address before the body-risk admonition.
findings.explanation: The serious warning drops the switch to Emiya-kun.

findings.highlight: Practicing magecraft that goes beyond its caster's limits leads only to ruin.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の限界を超えた魔術は、術者を廃人にするわ。
findings.governingReading: 廃人 names severe loss of human functioning after over-limit magecraft.
findings.explanation: Making the caster an incapacitated human wreck becomes generic ruin.

findings.highlight: At least for our peace of mind, take that painkiller if anything happens. If all goes well, your bruised and discolored skin might heal."
findings.evidenceJa: 気休めだろうけど、もしもの時の痛み止めぐらいは飲んどきなさい。うまくいけば、痣で変色した肌も治るかもしれないし」
findings.governingReading: もしもの時の痛み止め...飲んどきなさい directs advance consumption, and69 immediately shows him swallowing it.
findings.explanation: Taking medicine now for a possible emergency becomes taking it only if something happens.
